obj.cause: max() uses str.lower as the key, so it picks the lexicographically last word (case-insensitive), not the longest. For 'zz bbbb', 'zz' sorts after 'bbbb', so the assertion expecting 'bbbb' fails.
obj.change: Change the max key from str.lower to a length-based key (e.g. len) so the longest word is selected.
